text:
Ava: Quick follow-up from today’s all-hands Q&A. Sales and CS are asking for a small copy-paste note and the rollback story for model pinning/rollout UI, Optimize suggestions + export/apply, and streaming+function-calls GA ETA.

Rohit: Short status update to unblock comms: rollout UI (model pinning + progressive rollout) -> internal canary early-Aug, org-limited beta mid-Aug, GA conditional on canary metrics (aiming end of Aug). Optimize UI (in-console recommendations) -> console preview in Sept; export (CSV/JSON) and an opt-in apply API -> targeted for late Sept/early Oct. Streaming + function-calls -> SDKs and feature-flag GA in ~5 weeks, docs to follow. I'll post a slim RFC with the gating criteria tonight.

Gwen: Infra caveat: rollout UI depends on session-affinity scheduler (ENG-3011). There's an intermittent p99 jitter when pods rebalance. I'm triaging with runtime tomorrow morning; if that persists public beta slides by ~7-14 days. Repro snippet I used: ```kubectl -n infra logs deploy/session-scheduler | grep rebalance``` . Ping me for access.

Marcus: Rollback/guards summary for CS: rollout UI is behind per-org feature flags, staged ramp, and an automated fallback to the last-known-good model routing if p50 latency or error rate crosses threshold for 5 mins. We also have an emergency kill-switch for the feature flag. I'll add the PromQLs and dashboard links in the RFC.

Zoe: For external comms, please use month-level windows instead of hard dates. Suggested blurb for customers (one-liner): "Planned windows: model pinning + rollout UI (beta in Aug, GA after canary), Optimize recommendations in Sept with export and opt-in apply to follow, and streaming+function-calls reaching feature-flag GA in ~5 weeks. We'll share exact GA dates after canary and QA."

Ava: Perfect. Can someone drop a 1-2 line internal note for SDRs/AMs I can forward? They need copy/paste.

Rohit: Internal pasteable line: "Snapshot: rollout UI (canary -> org beta -> GA after canary), Optimize console preview in Sept with export and opt-in apply following, streaming+function-calls feature-flag GA ~5 weeks. Exact dates dependent on infra and QA gating."

Gwen: Also note Optimize one-click apply will be opt-in per-org and require a short evaluative run (1-3 hours) against a representative dataset before changing production routing. Export formats: CSV & JSON for v1.

Marcus: If anyone sees the session-scheduler rebalance repro, please add logs to ENG-3011 and ping me.

ci-bot: Canary reservation created: 2024-08-03 -> 2024-08-10. Link: <https://redwood.internal/releases/1851234567|canary-reserve> :spiral_calendar:
